current.text: Jusuf Nurkic is hurt, which raises Bailey's minutes to about 30 per game.
Jaxson Hayes started at center in the preseason because Utah does not want Jaren Jackson Jr. playing much center. That keeps Jackson at forward, in the spot Bailey would need to start.
Experts expect him to come off the bench for close to 30 minutes, even with Nurkic out.
His strong late-season numbers came while Utah sat its veterans. Experts say they will not repeat now that the team is healthy and trying to win.
Draft him only as a last-round flyer, outside the top 120.
He is worth more in points leagues (tier 6) than in category leagues (tier 8).
When Darryn Peterson and Lauri Markkanen sit, the offense should run through him and his stats could go up.
He is expected to be part of the closing lineup.
He is the number two prospect in the organization and could take Keyonte George's role as the secondary scorer within a year.
Utah has a crowded frontcourt and crowded usage with Markkanen, Jackson, George and Peterson. Minutes and usage should be all over the place early in the season.
Utah is trying to win this season and is not tanking, so experts do not expect late-season rest or shutdowns.

note: Yahoo ranks him 149 and ESPN ranks him 124, right at the edge of our 144-player pool. Both sites price him at about 1 USD, the same as our auction last season, so he is a 1 USD bench flyer at most and fine to leave on waivers. His projected line is flat at about 14 points and 1.9 threes, with no category strong or weak enough to anchor a build. Early in the season, check whether he gets about 30 minutes or a start while Nurkic is out, and how much he plays on nights when Markkanen or Peterson sit.
